heroHeadline: Iraq Completes al-Zaidi Cabinet as Dinar Devaluation Strains Public Finances
heroSubtitle: Parliament approved the remaining ministers and three deputy prime ministers on Oct 15, including Asaib Ahl al-Haq leader Laith al-Khazali. The government faces 208 trillion dinars of inherited debt and a ~15% dinar devaluation.
